decisions.reason: Visibility rose from a mention to a page of its own, which signals results meeting aspirations, and identity delegation complements the core GIS integration offer at low carrying cost.

The open framework underpins the firm's extensible-component strategy, so even with flat visibility the growing industry gives it enough slack to keep developing the line rather than search for alternatives.
Promotion was stepped up with a dedicated page and specific launch claims about integrating GIS applications into existing user management, indicating performance above aspiration.
The consulting workshop is newly launched, uses the existing consultants and trainers at little cost, and is too early to judge against aspirations, so slack allows it to continue.
